name: periodic_helix_9_octave
title: Unified 3D Nine-Octave Periodic Helix of the Elements
description: Single 3D 9-octave conical helical wave of the elements whose axial projection (X, Y) yields Russell's 1926 concentric periodic chart (Fig. 177) and whose lateral projection (Z, Y) yields the corkscrew octave wave (Fig. 180).
